mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, name, kana, gender, birthday, email, password, phone_number AS phoneNumber, postal_code AS postalCode, address FROM t_users ORDER BY user_id

SELECT user_id AS userId, name, kana, gender, birthday, email, password, phone_number AS phoneNumber, postal_code AS postalCode, address FROM t_users
AND name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND gender LIKE '%' || #{gender} || '%'
AND address LIKE '%' || #{address} || '%'
SELECT user_id AS userId, name, kana, gender, birthday, email, password, phone_number AS phoneNumber, postal_code AS postalCode, address FROM t_users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_users SET name = #{name}, kana = #{kana}, email = #{email}, password = #{password}, birthday = #{birthday}, gender = #{gender}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, address = #{address}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
